findings.title: [P2] Preserve defined names that trim to an empty string
findings.body: When `profile.name` is empty or whitespace-only, `trim()` returns `""`. The previous nullish fallback preserved that defined value, while the new `||` fallback returns `"Anonymous"`. This changes observable behavior despite the stated goal of preserving existing contracts.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of treating them as absent
findings.body:
For valid inputs such as `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the function now returns `"Anonymous"` instead of the previously returned empty string. Using `||` changes the established API behavior for empty-but-defined names despite the stated contract-preservation requirement.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
